intro: Select a library and collection. The app loads items in the configured Weeding work order and validates Statistical Note 2.
title: Title
blocked: Weeding is blocked because at least one item has an empty or invalid reason.
ready: All reasons are valid. Select one of the used reasons for preview/export/weeding.
readOnly: Test version: read-only. No item will be changed.
withdrawalHelp: Select one target withdrawal location for each library. The default CTU configuration contains ARCH → A99, DKD → 89999, FBMI/UBMI → U99, FD → 69999 and FJFI → 49999. Values can be changed for another institution.
noMappings: No withdrawal location mapping is configured.
coming: This tab will be enabled after the read-only test of the first step.
importHelp: Import only loads and validates the configuration. Changes are saved only after clicking “Save settings”.
importedNotSaved: Configuration loaded and validated. It has not been saved yet.
invalidConfigFile: The file is not a valid Weeding app configuration.
fullReportHint: This is a pre-weeding control list, not the final weeding register. Export and printing include all items in the selected scope, including ERR rows. The app preview is paginated.
printUnavailable: Unable to open the print preview.
printPreviewReady: The preview was opened in a new tab. Click “Print” there to print or save as PDF.
printPopupBlocked: The browser blocked the print preview window. Allow popups for this Cloud App and try again.
scanCode: Circulation desk or department code for Completed
unconfiguredHelp: Libraries with incomplete mapping are visible but cannot be used for write operations. Any number of libraries is supported.
enableWrites: Enable modifying operations in this environment
writeSafetyHelp: Writes require Alma roles, verified environment, and validation of records before each job.
importReviewed: I have verified sequences, withdrawal locations and circulation desks.
writeDisabled: Write operations are disabled. An administrator must enable them in configuration.
weedingSafety: The entire location is rechecked before creating a historical set and running job to assign numbers and date.
doneIntro: Select a library and the original location. Mark as Withdrawn uses a bulk job on the original itemized weeding set, containing items with assigned weeding numbers and dates.
moveIntro: Choose the original library and location. job moves completed items into the configured withdrawal location without changing weeding numbers or dates.
firstFifty: Only the first 50 items are previewed. The action applies to the entire loaded group.
historyCurrentData: The list displays current Alma data, not a historical snapshot.
doneDepartmentConfigured: Configured target department for Mark as Withdrawn
doneDepartmentMissing: No target Withdrawn department is configured for the selected library. Enter its internal ID in the app configuration before running this operation.
doneRequestsNotice: Pending requests are not canceled automatically.
